arguments.summary: APT-29 (Cozy Bear) activity detected originating from a spearphishing attachment delivered via a compromised partner email. The threat actor established persistence on domain controller DC-01 (10.0.8.200) using a scheduled task under the Guest account. C2 beaconing was observed to 198.51.100.77 over HTTPS, matching known TTPs. Initial access likely occurred via WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) after user jsmith opened a malicious payload. Lateral movement attempts were detected via SMB and Kerberos. The C2 IP has been blocked at the firewall, and the domain controller scanned with no active threats found.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation by Guest Account
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4688
conditions:
  - CommandLine|contains: 'schtasks.exe'
  - User|contains: 'Guest'
  - CommandLine|contains: '/RU'
  - CommandLine|contains: 'SYSTEM'
level: critical
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1053/005/
description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks by the Guest account, often abused for persistence by adversaries.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Jitter_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing with jittered HTTPS traffic"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_jitter = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 }
        $useragent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $uri_path = "/admin/get.php" ascii
    condition:
        $useragent and $uri_path and filesize < 500KB
}
